all_skills: Lead Data Scientist specializing in Agentic AI at US Technology International
with a proven track record in developing advanced AI architectures and integrations. Spearheaded initiatives that drive innovation in AI technology adoption and implementation
resulting in enhanced operational efficiency. Expertise in leveraging data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making and optimize performance

responsibilities: Orchestrated agent-based workflows employing LangChain, Crew AI, and Semantic Kernel.
Led cross-functional teams to align AI initiatives with business objectives.
Researched and implemented emerging AI methodologies to drive innovation.
Provided technical leadership to DevOps and IT teams for enhanced collaboration.
Served as strategic advisor to clients, maintaining expertise in latest AI technologies.
Design, train, and optimized generative AI and LLM-based models for diverse applications
Developed computer vision models for component recognition, defect detection, and automated annotation
Utilize frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow, and integrate annotation tools such as CVAT into the training pipeline.
Cloud Architecture & Integration:

Implemented scalable ML pipelines and model hosting on AWS using services such as Amazon S3, EC2, SageMaker, Lambda, and ECS/EKS. Ensure that deployed models meet performance, availability, and cost requirements.
Data Management & Experimentation:
Worked with large, heterogeneous datasets—including CAD files, images of assembly drawings, and operation manuals—ensuring proper preprocessing and augmentation.
Implemented MLOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, versioning, monitoring, and automated retraining.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Collaborated with team members, engineers, architects, and material scientists to understand project needs and translate them into AI-driven solutions. Clearly communicated complex AI concepts and results to non-technical stakeholders, providing actionable insights.
Research & Innovation:

Kept place with the latest advancements in generative AI, LLMs, and computer vision. Experiment with cutting-edge models and techniques (e.g., diffusion models, transformer-based architectures, self-supervised learning) to enhance capabilities.
Technical Expertise:

Proven track record in training and deploying advanced deep learning models at scale. Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow. Solid experience with AWS ML services (SageMaker, ECS, Lambda), and MLOps frameworks. Hands-on experience with computer vision annotation tools (e.g., CVAT) and related data labeling workflows.
Worked with retrieval-augmented generation systems (RAGS) and AWS generative AI services like AWS Bedrock
With a robust background in AI/ML-based application design & development, I specialize in creating cutting-edge generative AI applications and prompt engineering
I have worked on TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, retrieval-augmented generation systems (RAGS), and AWS generative AI services such as AWS Bedrock
I thrive in an Azure DevOps (ADO) environment, excelling in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and scrum meetings
